explanation.refundImage: Image tasks refund reserved credits on failure or timeout and settle only successful outputs. Timed-out tasks are never charged.
explanation.refundVideo: Video tasks refund reserved credits on failure or timeout. Timed-out tasks are never charged.
explanation.refundSync: {{tools}} refund credits on failure or timeout (resubmit required). Free {{bgRemove}} restores monthly free quota on failure or timeout.
